title: Add Queue File Settings probe facts
summary: Add a read-only Detected file info panel to the Queue File Settings drawer using facts already returned by the file-overrides tracks probe.
reason: Operators need source size, duration, bitrate, container, video basics, and probe gaps near per-file audio/subtitle/routing overrides so override decisions can be based on current probe evidence.
behavior_before: The Queue File Settings drawer showed detected audio/subtitle tracks but did not surface source-level probe facts such as file size, duration, container, overall bitrate, estimated bitrate, or primary video basics.
behavior_after: The existing additive file-overrides tracks payload includes source_info and audio stream bitrate displays, effective track metadata preserves source_info, and the drawer renders a compact read-only Detected file info panel with loading, unavailable, and partial-data states.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m pytest tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_web_static.py -k file_settings_drawer -q -- passed, 11 passed and 27 deselected
apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/refresh_summaries.py --paths <feature files> -- wrote 7 summaries and left 1 unchanged; a second focused refresh wrote the static-test summary
No File Settings drawer-specific ops/scripts/smoke wrapper was present; the closest Queue row-detail wrapper does not exercise this drawer panel.
rollback_plan: Revert the source_info payload normalization, selector preservation, File Settings drawer markup/rendering/CSS, focused test updates, refreshed summaries, and this change packet.
notes: Read-only additive Local API/WebView feature. It keeps schema_version queue_file_override_tracks.v1, adds no POST route or frontend mutation path, and does not change FFmpeg command generation, route policy, subtitle policy, audio policy, queue mutation, pending publish drain, source/scratch/output movement, cleanup behavior, or source media files. Affected Python scripts: app/api/file_overrides/tracks.py, app/api/file_overrides/selectors.py, tests/python/desktop/test_file_override_tracks.py, and tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_web_static.py.
